entities.name: Le Monde Illustré
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Le Monde illustré was a leading illustrated news magazine in France which was published from 1857–1940 and again from 1945 to 1956. It was in many ways similar to its contemporary English-language newsmagazine The Illustrated London News and should not be confused with the French newspaper Le Monde.
